title: Articles 33–35 — Armed forces, martial law, Part III legislation

content.heading: Power to modify rights; martial law; legislation to give effect to Part III
content.text: Article 33 empowers Parliament to modify the application of Part III to members of the Armed Forces and certain other forces. Article 34 addresses restriction of rights while martial law is in force in any area. Article 35 confers legislative power on Parliament for certain Part III matters and punishments despite the ordinary distribution of legislative powers. Canonical: provision:india:constitution-art-33, art-34, art-35.
